text:
elena: Quick design QA — thinking about the trace viewer contextual actions. Do we want the export / copy / link CTAs to live inline with the stack frame, or only in the header action bar?

sachin: inline feels more discoverable when you're focused on a frame, but it clutters the flow. header keeps consistent, easier keyboard target.

maya: +1 to discoverability. Users often want to copy a correlation id next to a specific span.

elena: Right — one idea: show a subtle kebab (⋯) inline that expands to a mini menu with Copy ID / Export Span / Open Request. Default hidden, keyboard-focusable.

tom: Concern: inline menus add a tab stop per frame. For long traces that could be dozens of extra stops. We should ensure a single predictable nav pattern.

aria-bot: a11y hint: new interactive elements should have aria-label and role=button; use aria-expanded on toggle states.

elena: sketching compromise: only render inline menu for hovered/focused frame; otherwise actions are in header. Keyboard nav: pressing \"f\" focuses next frame, then press \"m\" to open menu. Thoughts?

sachin: love the keyboard chord idea. We need clear visual focus ring and to ensure screen reader announces \"Frame actions\". Example snippet:

```html
<button class=\"frame-menu\" aria-label=\"Frame actions for span 0x7f3\" aria-haspopup=\"true\">⋯</button>
```

maya: copy affordance: when copying correlation id, we should show a one-line inline toast near the frame instead of top-right toast so users see context.

elena: agree. Also considering a small icon that indicates \"copied\" state inline, so users know which span was copied.

tom: for export (har/trace), make it a background job with a toast that links to download. Inline menu should show \"Export (light)\" which triggers streaming download, and header export keeps advanced options.

aria-bot: accessibility nits: ensure the inline menu is reachable via ArrowDown/ArrowUp inside the menu, and ESC closes. Add skip-links for \"Jump to trace actions\" as well.

elena: copy text for the inline menu:
- Copy span id
- Copy correlation id
- Export span (light)
- Open request

maya: wording tweak: use \"Copy span ID\" and \"Copy correlation ID\" (capitalization consistent). 

sachin: small implementation note: prefer data-attributes for id in DOM: `data-span-id=\"...\"` so menu can operate without extra lookups.

elena: Accessibility question — if we hide the inline menu until focus/hover, will screen reader users discover it? We should expose it via a programmatic focus shortcut (e.g., press \"Shift+.`\" when focused on a frame).

tom: that's workable. We'll add a short product education tooltip the first time users hit that shortcut. 

maya: can we keep analytics: track \"inline-menu-opened\" vs \"header-export-used\" to see adoption.

elena: good call. Last thing: copy the correlation id button should read out full id to SR. Example aria-live behavior: `aria-live=\"polite\"` with visible announcement.

sachin: implementation checklist I'll take: focus ring + keyboard shortcut, aria labels, data-attrs, inline toast placement.

elena: thanks! I'll update the mock and send frames for review. If folks are happy I'll land copy edits in the component file. :thumbsup:
